cells.gaps: The 85.6% is the central bank's banking rate for the resident population and is not attributed to a survey. No survey found since November 2023 puts adults who made or received a digital payment at 79% or more.
cells.note: The Banco de Cabo Verde's 2025 payment system report puts residents holding a current or payment account at 85.6%, four in five or more; not attributed to a survey, staged on it as the ladder is read now. No survey gives the share paying digitally.
